sections.Profile:
The Incredible Hulk, released by Gottlieb in October 1979, is a four-player solid-state game designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison, and one of the first licensed pinball machines based on a Marvel comic book character.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Celebrity, Fictional Character, Licensed, 1970s, Solid State, Comics, Superhero
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Gordon Morison
sections.Editions: - The Incredible Hulk: 6,150 made, released 1979-01-01, model number 433, Gottlieb System 1
